Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Problem.name: Problem
Problem.comment:
A record of work an agent wakes on (D104). The agent sets wake-ups on it:
after a delay, at an interval, or on a cron line in a time zone, a minute
to thirty days apart, at most ten a record, one live name each. Each wake
reaches the app's handler, which tells the agent and reports told,
resumed, held or missed; a missed one is tried again five minutes on. A
record that is done or dropped finishes its wake-ups.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

ProblemChange.name: ProblemChange
ProblemChange.comment: The writes of Problem's rows its behaviors hear, one message per write, whoever makes it, which a trigger of the table writes and a behavior worker runs (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Problem row written.

fields.name: write
fields.description: What the write did: insert, update or delete.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the write was made, in epoch milliseconds, by the database's clock.

fields.name: before
fields.description: The row's columns before the write, by column, as JSON; null for an insert.

fields.name: after
fields.description: The row's columns after the write, by column, as JSON; null for a delete.

ProblemDeadline.name: ProblemDeadline
ProblemDeadline.comment: The deadlines Problem's behaviors arm, one message per row, use and deadline, due when it falls due (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Problem row the deadline is armed on.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that armed it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name, the use's own.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was armed to fall due, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the use armed it with, which its deadline hook reads.

ProblemEvent.name: ProblemEvent
ProblemEvent.comment: The events Problem's behaviors emit about its rows, one message per event, written in the command's transaction, which a behavior worker hands to the project's handler (D104).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Problem row the event is about.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that emitted it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The event's kind, as its behavior declares it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: The time of the command that emitted it, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the event says, as its kind's payloadSchema types it.

ProblemSchedulesSchedules.name: ProblemSchedulesSchedules
ProblemSchedulesSchedules.comment: One row per schedule of the row, keyed by its name: its kind and spec, its time zone, its state, when it was set, its next run and the retry of its latest one, how many runs it has had and which attempt of the latest fired last and when, the outcome reported of it, and when and why it finished. A finished schedule stays until its name is set again, or until the row keeps more than max finished ones, when those finished longest ago go.

fields.name: problem
fields.description: The Problem row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The schedule's name, its key on the row.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: after, every or cron.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: The delay or the interval in milliseconds, as its digits, or the cron line, its fields one space apart.

fields.name: timeZone
fields.description: The IANA time zone a cron line is read in, as the bundled database spells it; absent for after and every.

fields.name: state
fields.description: active, paused or finished.

fields.name: setAt
fields.description: When it was set, in epoch milliseconds: an every schedule's runs fall at whole intervals from it.

fields.name: nextAt
fields.description: When its next regular run falls due, in epoch milliseconds; absent once it has none.

fields.name: retryAt
fields.description: When its latest run is tried again, before nextAt, in epoch milliseconds; absent unless a retry is armed.

fields.name: runs
fields.description: How many runs the name has had: a replace, and a finished name set again, count on from it.

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: Which attempt of its latest run fired last: 1, and one more for each retry; absent before its first run.

fields.name: lastAt
fields.description: When its latest attempt fired, in epoch milliseconds; absent before its first run.

fields.name: lastOutcome
fields.description: The outcome reported of its latest attempt; absent until one is.

fields.name: finishedAt
fields.description: When it finished, in epoch milliseconds; absent while it is live.

fields.name: endedBy
fields.description: What finished it: run, its last run fired; cancel, cancelSchedule; endOn, the row's Workflow entered a state endOn names. Absent while it is live.
